description: This file implements a command for verifying backup archives, including parsing manifest files, validating archive contents, and producing verification results.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a record object.

methods.name: stripTrailingSlashes
methods.description: Removes trailing slashes from a string.

methods.name: normalizeArchivePath
methods.description: Normalizes and validates archive entry paths to be relative and safe.

methods.name: normalizeArchiveRoot
methods.description: Normalizes the archive root to a single path segment.

methods.name: isArchivePathWithin
methods.description: Checks if a path is within a specified parent directory.

methods.name: parseManifest
methods.description: Parses and validates a backup manifest JSON string.

methods.name: listArchiveEntries
methods.description: Lists all entries in a tar archive.

methods.name: extractManifest
methods.description: Extracts the manifest JSON content from an archive.

methods.name: isRootManifestEntry
methods.description: Determines if an archive entry is the root manifest.

methods.name: verifyManifestAgainstEntries
methods.description: Validates archive entries against the manifest's expected structure.

methods.name: formatResult
methods.description: Formats verification result into a human-readable string.

methods.name: findDuplicateNormalizedEntryPath
methods.description: Detects duplicate normalized archive entry paths.

methods.name: backupVerifyCommand
methods.description: Main function to verify a backup archive, parse manifest, validate contents, and output results.
